title: How to Cancel Hulu — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your Hulu subscription in 2 minutes. Works for Hulu Basic, No Ads, and Live TV plans. Keep access until the end of your billing period.
intro: Canceling Hulu is quick and can be done entirely online. Your account stays active through the end of your current billing period, so you won't lose access immediately.

steps.title: Go to your Hulu Account page
steps.text: Visit secure.hulu.com/account in your browser and sign in. You can also access this from the Hulu app by tapping your profile → Account.

steps.title: Click "Cancel" under Your Subscription
steps.text: In the Your Subscription section, click "Cancel". If you have the Disney Bundle, you'll see options to manage individual services.
steps.tip: If you're on a Hulu + Live TV plan, consider switching to the basic Hulu plan ($7.99/mo) first — you might only need to drop Live TV.

steps.title: Decline the retention offer
steps.text: Hulu may offer you a discounted rate, a plan switch, or a pause option. Click "Continue to Cancel" if you want to proceed with full cancellation.
steps.tip: Hulu's pause feature (up to 12 weeks) is genuinely useful if you're on the fence. You won't be charged during the pause.

steps.title: Confirm your cancellation
steps.text: Click "Cancel Subscription" on the final confirmation screen. You'll see your last date of access. An email confirmation will be sent to your registered email.

warnings: If you subscribed through Apple, Roku, or Amazon, you must cancel through their billing systems — not on Hulu's website.
If you have the Disney Bundle through Hulu, canceling Hulu cancels the entire bundle including Disney+ and ESPN+.
Any add-ons (HBO Max, Showtime, etc.) purchased through Hulu will also be canceled.
Your profile, watchlist, and viewing history are preserved if you re-subscribe within a reasonable timeframe.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Hulu?
faqs.a: Hulu does not typically offer refunds for partial billing periods. If you were double-charged or experienced a billing error, contact Hulu support for resolution.

faqs.q: Will I lose my Hulu profiles if I cancel?
faqs.a: Hulu retains your profile data, viewing history, and preferences for some time after cancellation. If you re-subscribe within a few months, everything should be restored.

faqs.q: Can I cancel Hulu but keep Disney+?
faqs.a: Yes. If you have the Disney Bundle through Hulu, you can switch to Disney+ only. Go to Account → Manage Add-ons and adjust your bundle.

faqs.q: What happens to my Hulu + Live TV DVR recordings?
faqs.a: All cloud DVR recordings are deleted when your Live TV subscription ends. There's no way to save them externally.

refund.details: Hulu does not offer prorated refunds for unused portions of your billing cycle. Your access continues through the end of your current period.

retentionTactics: Hulu offers a 'pause subscription' option for up to 12 weeks with no charge.
They may offer a discounted rate for 2-3 months.
They'll suggest switching to a cheaper plan (e.g., from No Ads to With Ads tier).
